item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 3 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 3 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 2:00 PM, 16 August 2026(Sunday)

Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains are expected over Bataan, Metro Manila(Navotas, Malabon, Valenzuela, Quezon City, Caloocan, Marikina, Pasay, Manila, Makati, Mandaluyong, San Juan, Las Pinas, Paranaque, Pasig), Rizal(Rodriguez, San Mateo, Antipolo, Tanay, Pililla, Jala-Jala, Cainta, Baras), Quezon(General Nakar), Cavite(Rosario, Noveleta, Cavite City, Kawit, Bacoor, Imus, General Trias, Tanza, Naic, Ternate, Maragondon, Magallanes) and Batangas(Nasugbu, Lian).

Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Tarlac, Nueva Ecija(General Tinio, Penaranda, San Isidro, Gapan, Cabiao, San Antonio, Jaen, Zaragoza, San Leonardo, Santa Rosa, Cabanatuan, Laur, Palayan, Gabaldon, Aliaga, Talugtug, Cuyapo, Nampicuan, Licab, Guimba, Santo Domingo, Quezon, Talavera, Munoz, General Mamerto Natividad), Bulacan(San Miguel, Dona Remedios Trinidad, San Ildefonso, Calumpit, Hagonoy, Paombong, Plaridel, Pulilan, Malolos, San Rafael, Angat), Pampanga(Arayat, Magalang, Angeles, Mabalacat, Porac, San Fernando, Mexico, Bacolor, Santa Ana, Candaba, Macabebe, Masantol) and Zambales(San Marcelino, San Felipe, Botolan, Cabangan, Candelaria, Santa Cruz, Masinloc, Iba, Palauig) and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 12:50 PM, 16 August 2026(Sunday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Bulacan(Dona Remedios Trinidad, San Miguel) within the next 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in Nueva Ecija(General Tinio) which may persist within 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
